segments.an4.74:1.3: Sīlaggaṃ, samādhiggaṃ [samādhaggaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ)], paññāggaṃ, vimuttaggaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī”ti.

lines: Pañcame rūpagganti yaṃ rūpaṃ sammasitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, idaṃ rūpaggaṃ nāma.
Bhavagganti ettha pana yasmiṃ attabhāve ṭhito arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, etaṃ bhavaggaṃ nāmāti.
